current_revision.mathematical_scope: Arbitrary normal centers min(T_i)->infinity; full-residual strip total variation with explicit modulus; recursive submersion model, shrinking torus fibers, ambient-path escape control, moving offsets and all-radius ball total variation. Smooth reference curvature and bounded real primitive give Chern-Weil by finite-volume Stokes; verified KE background sign, dV=omega^m/m!, normal circle period 2pi, adjunction and zero-dimensional case. Full-corner densities give a.e. conditional residual measures and essential-uniform subcritical exponential moments. These actual moments give uniform weighted TV by Holder, unrestricted relative normal Abel rates, mixed component incidence and ordinary-volume vertex tightness/exact tail/joint/Laplace. Meromorphic continuation is separated by explicit residual-L1 joint-polyhomogeneity conditions and Laurent sign.
current_revision.not_verified: No exhaustive audit of the complete moving-basepoint/link-recovery arguments, Parts II-III or the external surface theorem. No new proof of family-uniform CP/PBE/TC, H_loc/H_anc or controlled push-off. No formal proof, external referee review or exhaustive novelty investigation. Existing exact/numerical certificate suites were not rerun.
